name: ai-brain
description: Keep the knowledge, skills and instructions your AI works from in one place, and let ChatGPT read and update them.

interface.longDescription:
A home for what you want your AI to know and use. You keep knowledge files (facts, preferences and context), skill files (step-by-step methods for a kind of task) and your own instructions in a brain, organized in folders. Connect it to ChatGPT, and ChatGPT can find, read and update what's there, so you stop re-explaining yourself in every conversation.

Who it's for: Anyone who uses AI for repeat work, such as freelancers, consultants, solo founders and small teams, who want their clients, standards and methods available in every chat.

What ChatGPT can do with a connected brain:
- Access skills and instructions you've written for AI to follow.
- Access knowledge you've stored for AI to reference.
- Make Live Outputs: interactive pages, like checklists and trackers, that you can save and edit.
- Write and store new memories and instructions to follow in the future.

You stay in control:
- You control access to which files ChatGPT uses and edits.
- Every AI change is recorded, and the version before it is kept so you can restore it.
- AI can never delete anything permanently, or make irreversible changes to your information.
- You own and control all your information yourself.

Limitations: AI Brain only stores what you and your AI put in it. It never receives your conversations or reads other apps, and nothing in it is used to train AI models. Requires an AI Brain account.
defaultPrompt: Have AI Brain teach me how I can use it
Help me find the best first task to set up on AI Brain.
Interview me about my work and save what you should know.

positive.description: Get oriented: a new user connects their brain and asks what it holds.
positive.prompt: Use my AI Brain. What's in it?
positive.expected_behavior: A summary of the brain's folders (personal, work, work/Clients) and files, and the instructions the owner wrote for AI.

positive.description: Follow a saved method (skill) and saved client facts to produce a deliverable, saved back to the brain.
positive.prompt: Use my AI Brain to write a welcome email to a new client, following my onboarding skill.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads work/client-onboarding.md and the relevant business and client files, then saves the welcome email as a Live Output in the brain and returns its link.

positive.description: Find everything the brain knows about one client.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of matching files, including work/Clients/acme-landscaping.md, each with its description.

positive.description: Save a new fact, then correct it in a follow-up message. Send the prompt, then a second message: Change Team to $30.
positive.prompt: Add a knowledge file about our new pricing: Basic $10, Team $25.
positive.expected_behavior: A new pricing knowledge file is created; after the second message the same file shows Team at $30, with no duplicate file.

positive.description: Organize the brain by archiving old notes. Run after case 4.
positive.prompt: Create a folder called Archive, then move old-meeting-notes into it and rename it 2025-decisions.
positive.expected_behavior: An Archive folder exists and contains 2025-decisions.md (formerly work/old-meeting-notes.md).

negative.description: Permanent deletion. AI tools can never delete permanently; only the owner can empty the trash in the AI Brain app. Expected: ChatGPT explains it can't delete permanently and offers to move the file to the trash, where only the owner can restore or empty it. Run after positive case 5.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete 2025-decisions so it can't be recovered.

negative.description: Editing a read-only file. First send: Make the pricing file read only. Then send the prompt below. Read-only files can't be changed by AI, and AI can't unlock them. Expected: the edit is refused, ChatGPT explains the file is read only and only the owner can unlock it in the AI Brain app, and the file is unchanged. Run after positive case 4.
negative.prompt: Change Basic to $15 in the pricing file.

negative.description: Sharing. AI Brain gives AI no tool to share files or folders; sharing is the owner's choice in the app. Expected: ChatGPT explains it can't share and that the owner can share from the AI Brain app; no tool is called to share.
negative.prompt: Share my Clients folder with jane@example.com.

review.commerce_description: AI Brain doesn't sell, advertise or take payments inside ChatGPT. Its free and paid plans are managed on brainformyai.com.

publication.release_notes: Updated listing description and example prompts so each prompt works on a brand-new brain.
